title: Northgate Tire Center Rate Sheet — Fitting a Treadwear Replacement Tire
content:
# Rate sheet: fitting a tire replaced under the treadwear mileage warranty

**Charge.** The claim fitting charge on a Northgate Tire Center package is the package's package price per tire, for the one tire fitted, rounded to the cent.

## What enters the charge

| Item | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Package price per tire | the package price per tire of the package held |
| Number of tires charged | one — the tire fitted on the wheel replaced under the claim |
| Rounding | the charge is carried at full precision and rounded to the cent once, at the end; no intermediate amount is rounded on its own |

The charge is one tire's worth of the package price, whatever the number of tires in the set: a four-tire set and a five-tire set with a full-size spare are charged alike for one fitted tire.

## Worked figure (hypothetical package price)

| Hypothetical package price per tire | Tires fitted | Claim fitting charge |
|---|---|---|
| $24.50 | 1 | $24.50 |
| $33.00 | 1 | $33.00 |
